entries.title: Numbers 9:3
segments: As the death of Christ is the procuring cause of the salvation of his people, it is his will that they should from time to time to celebrate it according to his appointment, with humility, penitence, gratitude, and joy.

entries.title: Numbers 9:11
segments: The fourteenth day of the second month; this was in the month Zif, and one month after the usual time of keeping the passover.

entries.title: Numbers 9:13
segments:
Forbeareth to keep the passover; at the usual time. 
 
To obey God, we must neither neglect to commemorate the death of Christ, nor do it in an unholy manner; but must examine ourselves and see whether we believe on him, feel our need of his salvation,a nd make it our great object in all things to do his will.

entries.title: Numbers 9:18
segments: At the commandment of the Lord; as manifested by the moving or resting of the cloud.

entries.title: Numbers 9:23
segments: If we are disposed to obey God, he will, by his word, his Spirit, and his providence, make so plain the path of duty, that in walking in it we shall be safe, useful, and happy.
